name: Jim Wells County, TX
findings: Jim Wells County has 54 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jim Wells County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Jim Wells County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Jim Wells County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
